name: Living / immobile controller

name: Six Paths of Pain / prepared bodies
limitations: One identity with six prepared remote corpse bodies, not six extra draft slots or an additional restored Nagato. Shared vision needs active bodies and signal range; Deva cooldown, destroyed bodies and costly large attacks constrain the set.

name: Deva Path / remaining battle body
limitations: Only the remotely controlled Deva body remains in this snapshot. No other Path summons, absorption or body repairs; gravity timing and Nagato's strained reserves matter.

name: Reanimated / depleted body
limitations: Depleted body and restricted mobility; restoration needs a successful external chakra drain. No simultaneous Six Paths corpses; sealing can stop Edo recovery.

name: Reanimated / restored after absorption
limitations: Restored snapshot starts after demonstrated chakra absorption, not an unlimited free refill. Mobility remains limited; absorption needs applicable contact and reanimation remains sealable. No six-body team added.
